purpose: External benchmark of which modules and SuiteApps fit each micro-vertical. BPC has no proprietary base of NetSuite accounts to compare against, so the reference comes from public sources — not from our own clients.

sources.title: NetSuite SuiteSuccess Editions: Comprehensive ERP Guide
sources.note: Third-party summary of Oracle's SuiteSuccess editions, not official documentation. Useful to frame the conversation; do NOT cite it as Oracle's word in front of a client.

caveat: SuiteSuccess prescribes a starting point per industry, not an obligation. A module appearing in a vertical's edition does not mean this client needs it — that is a question for the meeting, not a finding. Everything derived from here is a suggested change to validate with the client.

events-dmc.suiteSuccessEdition: No SuiteSuccess edition exists for events/DMC. The closest is Services (PSA). That is a finding in itself: the niche is poorly served by the standard and gets solved with third-party SuiteApps.

industrySuiteApps.name: ConventionSuite
industrySuiteApps.what: event and service management built on NetSuite

events-dmc.keyMetric: Profitability PER PROGRAM (event). The model is pass-through: gross revenue is misleading and the real margin lives in the management fee.

redFlags.say: Events are run as billing containers, without PSA. With no project tasks and no time-to-charge there is no per-event margin — which is the one metric that matters in a pass-through model.
A DMC spends on-site at every destination. If expense reports do not live in NetSuite, the true event cost is assembled outside the system.

saas.keyMetric: ARR / MRR, churn and renewal rate.

redFlags.say: Revenue recognition is running but SuiteBilling is not: subscriptions and renewals are handled manually or outside NetSuite.
Projects with no time-to-charge: no utilization and no per-project margin.

agency.keyMetric: Net revenue (not gross), because of media pass-through.

manufacturing.keyMetric: Standard vs actual cost variances, yield.

media.keyMetric: Campaign ROI, subscription churn, revenue per CPM.

construction.suiteSuccessEdition: No dedicated edition; built on Services + Projects.

nonprofit.keyMetric: Restricted vs unrestricted funds, program service ratio.
